title: ComponentNode
description: A single component in the flat node array produced by the encoder. The root node is first; children reference other nodes by id. `watches` is the deduplicated, insertion-ordered union of every StateValue.key reachable from `props`, used by the Flutter SDK to know which state keys trigger a re-render of this node.

id.description: Stable component id. Equals `widget.key` if set, otherwise a monotonically assigned encoder counter (as a decimal string).

props.description: Resolved props. Leaves are either plain JSON values (fully resolved) or Value objects (partially resolved — state/event refs preserved for the SDK).

children.description: Ordered child ids. For StructureWidget slots, slot ids also appear here (and are additionally referenced by name inside `props`).

watches.description: Insertion-ordered unique list of StateValue keys reachable from `props`. Clients subscribe to these keys.

actions.description: Map of trigger name (`onTap`, `onChange`, ...) to Action. Action triggers are defined by the widget kind.
